senses.gloss: (v. פָּסַס) to separate, part, tear (into stripes, shreds).
units: <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 7:4">Midr. Till. to Ps. VII, 3</cite> <he>מה האריה … ומְפַסְפְּסוֹ כך … לפַסְפְּסֵנִי</he> (Var. in Ms. <he>מפצפצ׳</he>, v. ed. Bub. note) as the lion sits over his prey and tears it, so Doeg and Ahithophel sit over me to tear me; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 637">Yalk. Ps. 637</cite>; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 22">Midr. Till. to Ps. XXII, 17</cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 24:2">Sabb. XXIV, 2</cite> <he>מְפַסְפְּסִים את הכיפים</he> you may (untie and) spread the bundles (of fodder), v. <cite ref="K00603"><he>כִּיפָּה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Shabbat 155a:6">Ib. 155ᵃ</cite> <he>לא לפַסְפֵּס ולא להתיר</he> neither to spread nor even to untie.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 3:18">Tosef. ib. III</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 4:18">IV</cite>), 18 <he>מפספסין את הכפין ובלבד וכ׳</he> (Var. <he>ומפרכסין</he>, incorr.) you may part the bundles, provided you do not pluck them apart.

<cite ref="Mishnah Nazir 6:3">Naz. VI, 3</cite> <he>נזיר חופף ומְפַסְפֵּס</he> the Nazarite may wash his hair (v. <cite ref="H01464"><he>חָפַף</he></cite>) and part it (with his fingers), but must not use a comb. Y. ib. IV, 55ᵇ top <he>מפספסין בקליקין</he> you may part the tangles in the Nazarite’s hair; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Beitzah 4:3:8">Y. Bets. IV, 62ᶜ</cite>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shekalim 3:2:10">Y. Shek. III, 47ᶜ</cite> <he>הגיזברין היו מפספסין בקילקין</he> the Temple treasurers had the entangled hair (of those engaged in counting) straightened (to avoid the suspicion that they had coins concealed); a. e.
